issue_request: FHIR-17998 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Financial Management request to add PaymentReconciliation.detail.identifier as a 0..1 Identifier business identifier for the payment detail.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged historical batch commit f369c813 applied the PaymentReconciliation STU3 tracker set including GF#17998, adding the payment-detail identifier semantics and example detail identifiers to the spreadsheet-era source.
additional_context: Later PaymentReconciliation work, especially FHIR-26601, intentionally renamed the detail backbone to allocation. source/fhir.ini maps PaymentReconciliation.detail.identifier to PaymentReconciliation.allocation.identifier, and the current StructureDefinition defines allocation.identifier as 0..1 Identifier with the requested business identifier meaning. FHIR-18005 is already represented on the combined branch for the related search-parameter work. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current active source already preserves the requested STU3 .detail.identifier as PaymentReconciliation.allocation.identifier with matching cardinality, datatype, definition, requirements, and example usage.
